text:
maia: FYI EdgeFabric reported customers being billed ~3x due to currency_code flip in their gateway (USD -> EUR) when events hit marketplace. Need quick mitigation + reconciliation plan.
dave: looks like gateway v3.0 set default currency to EUR if header missing. ingestion should've normalized.
sora: Billing shows mismatch: ledger unit_price in cents_usd vs event.price_cents and currency. This created inflated charges on 2025-08-21.
maia: partner says many edge devices batched without headers when offline. They can backfill but want automated detection and webhook.
dave: short-term: ingestion rule to prefer partner_metadata.currency when present, else fallback to account.default_currency. Also flag events where event.currency != account.currency for manual review.
lina: ops mitigation: add a metric `marketplace.ingest.currency_mismatch` and alert if >100 in 10m. Also add ledger write guard for the affected settlement window to prevent double-apply during recon.
sora: reconciliation playbook draft: 1) query suspect events, 2) group by customer & day, 3) compute delta between ledger_charged and expected_charges_usd using exchange rates at event_time, 4) mark provisional_adjustments with audit tag, 5) create off-cycle credit/charge file.
maia: sample SQL to find suspect rows?
dave: SQL:
```
SELECT partner_id, customer_id, count(*) AS events, sum(tokens) AS total_tokens, array_agg(distinct currency) AS currencies
FROM partner_usage_events
WHERE received_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND (currency IS DISTINCT FROM account_currency OR currency IS NULL)
GROUP BY partner_id, customer_id
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
sora: Partner webhook they asked for (backfill notification):
```
POST /partners/edgefabric/webhooks/usage-backfill
{
  "event_id": "evt-xyz-20250821",
  "device_id": "ef-00123",
  "observed_at": "2025-08-21T14:12:00Z",
  "currency": "USD",
  "price_cents": 150
}
```
lina: deployment notes: put the currency-normalization behind feature flag `currency_safe_mode_v1`, warm up cache of account.default_currency for 7 days. add runbook entry in eng-oncall.
dave: ownership & ETA: I'll push normalization + metric in 24h to staging. lina adds alert and ledger guard in 12h. sora prepares finance policy & customer comms in 18h. maia will coordinate partner QA.
integrations-bot: Created job id backfill-edgefabric-20250822, owner dave, runs staging 2025-08-22T03:00:00Z.
maia: thanks — we'll review recon output after the staging job. :thumbsup:
